sources: UPPRPB PET notice dated 24-09-2026, which recaps the written exam, result and DV/PST schedule: https://uppbpb.gov.in/FilesUploaded/Notice/72006016e1ebae-500c-4578-98d2-0e511181b7a7.pdf
UPPRPB notice board (https://uppbpb.gov.in/Home/Notice) for Advertisement 07/2025, DV notice dated 23-09-2026 and result notices
Result and shortlist figures from dated reports on timesofindia.indiatimes.com and testbook.com (cross-check the shortlist notice)

Applications for the 2026 cycle ran on the recruitment portal named in the board's notices, upcons2025.com, with One Time Registration, a real-time photograph, Aadhaar-based authentication and DigiLocker uploads (fee ₹500 for General, EWS and OBC, ₹400 for SC/ST)

admitCard.where: Download link on uppbpb.gov.in, released city- and centre-wise
admitCard.when: About a week before the fixed exam date, per the board's notice dated 24 September 2026
steps: Open uppbpb.gov.in and open the admit card download link for your city or centre.
Enter the login details asked on the page and download the admit card.
Print the admit card clearly and check your name, roll number, centre, date and shift.
If the link for your centre is not live yet, keep checking the notice board page; admit cards are uploaded centre by centre.
carry: An original photo ID (Aadhaar card, voter ID or any ID listed in the admit card instructions)
Only what the admit card instructions allow; mobile phones and electronic devices are not permitted inside

answerKey.summary: The board publishes the provisional answer key and question papers shift-wise on its website and invites objections within a notified window.
steps: Open uppbpb.gov.in and open the answer key link for your shift.
Download your shift's question paper and provisional answer key, and compare them question by question.
Submit objections online within the notified window, following the format the notice asks for.
The board examines the objections and publishes the final answer key.
answerKey.fee: The objection fee, if any, is stated in the notice for that cycle. Check the official notice rather than assuming.
answerKey.note: The written exam was held on 8, 9 and 10 June 2026 in two shifts a day across 75 districts, so keys are published shift-wise.

result.summary: **The final selection result for Constable Civil Police and equivalent posts, direct recruitment 2025 (Advertisement 07/2025), was published on 14 October 2026.** The [official final-result notice](https://uppbpb.gov.in/FilesUploaded/Notice/const%2014%20Oct%202026c0201978-124f-4557-9c66-e162a881cb82.pdf) confirms that the PET ran from **1 to 11 October 2026**, including the revised centre schedules. Check the final-result link reached through [UPPRPB](https://uppbpb.gov.in/) and follow subsequent document, medical and appointment instructions. The final result is separate from the written-exam shortlist of 31 July.

stages.what: One OMR paper of 150 questions for 300 marks (2 marks each) in 2 hours, with 0.5 negative marking for wrong answers and no sectional timing. Result declared on 31 July 2026, shortlisting around 76,184 candidates for document verification/PST and PET.

Original certificates are checked: education, age, caste in the prescribed Prakoshtha formats, UP residence for reservation, and ex-servicemen or NOC documents where applicable. Physical standards: male minimum height 168 cm (ST 160 cm), chest 79 to 84 cm with 5 cm expansion; female minimum height 152 cm (ST 147 cm), weight 40 kg. Measurements taken here are final.

The final-result notice confirms that PET was completed from 1 to 11 October 2026 after centre-specific changes. PET is qualifying; final merit uses the normalised written-examination score and the applicable reservation and preference rules.

Published on 14 October 2026 for direct recruitment 2025, Advertisement 07/2025. Read the [board notice](https://uppbpb.gov.in/FilesUploaded/Notice/const%2014%20Oct%202026c0201978-124f-4557-9c66-e162a881cb82.pdf) and use the result lookup linked by UPPRPB; follow subsequent official instructions.

result.scorecard: Results, cutoffs and DV/PST/PET schedules are published as PDF notices on uppbpb.gov.in, and candidates look up their roll number in the list.
